subject: fire ant
title: A Fly Smaller Than a Grain of Rice Makes Fire Ants Lose Their Heads

scenes.text: A fly smaller than a grain of rice can make a fire ant's head fall off.
It hovers over the ant, then injects one egg into its body, in a split second.
The ant looks fine. The larva crawls into its head and drinks its blood.
Then the ant walks away from the colony, alone, and just keeps going.
The larva releases an enzyme. The head loosens, and it drops off.
Weeks later, a new fly climbs out of the empty head.

description:
A tiny phorid fly can make a fire ant's head fall off.
It injects an egg into the ant, and the larva moves into the head and feeds there.
The head drops off, and the new fly emerges from it weeks later.
Would you rather be the ant or the fly?
first_comment: Would you release these flies to fight fire ants, or leave nature alone?
